system.notes: Public web tier: nginx reverse proxy (port 80/443) forwarding to a gunicorn app on :8000. App user: webapp. App lives under /srv/portal. Static assets served directly by nginx from /srv/portal/static.

Internal fleet status API: Python FastAPI app managed by systemd unit 'fleet-api.service'. Runs on :8080. App user: fleetapi. App directory: /opt/fleet-api. Uses a PostgreSQL 14 database on localhost:5432.
Booking portal: nginx (port 443, TLS) terminating SSL, proxying to a Node.js Express app on :3000. App user: booking. App directory: /srv/booking. TLS certificates stored under /etc/ssl/booking/.

Backup server: runs a custom backup script via systemd timer 'nightly-backup.timer' / 'nightly-backup.service'. Backup destination: /mnt/backupvol (NFS or block volume mount). Script path: /opt/backup/run_backup.sh. Backup user: backupagent.
Employee login portal: nginx (port 443) with TLS termination. TLS cert and key under /etc/nginx/ssl/. Backend app on :4000 managed by systemd unit 'employee-portal.service'. App user: empportal.

Reporting service: Python service managed by systemd unit 'reporting.service'. Connects to a PostgreSQL 14 database on localhost:5432, db name 'reports'. App user: reportinguser. Output directory: /srv/reports/monthly.
